en.quote: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove and go into captivity.
en.riddle: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done
en.speaker: God

he.quote: אֱמֹר אֲנִי מֽוֹפֶתְכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי כֵּן יֵעָשֶׂה לָהֶם בַּגּוֹלָה בַשְּׁבִי יֵלֵֽכוּ
he.speaker: אלוהים
